finding: The fixed partial channel-quantile grade brightens some warm surfaces but drives clouds toward pink and timber toward excessive red/orange. Global colour distribution differs because geometry/material/illumination coverage differs, so matching its quantiles does not solve colour fidelity.
decision: Reject the grade; preserve the actual render, curves and shader only as a bounded study. Do not add it to the current main scene or film.
remaining: Floor still has a fine mesh-like surface pattern requiring investigation of geometry/shading frequency coherence. Whole scene remains unaccepted.
